run_pybullet_visual_shape_simulation: run a pybullet simulation that creates instanced visual shapes from a mesh file and renders them in real time
create_visual_shape_from_mesh: create a visual shape from an OBJ mesh file with custom color, specular, scale, and frame position
create_collision_shape_from_mesh: create a collision shape from an OBJ mesh file with custom scale and frame position for physics simulation
create_multibody_with_shared_shapes: create a multi-body object that reuses a shared visual shape and collision shape for instancing
configure_pybullet_debug_visualizer: configure the pybullet debug visualizer to enable or disable rendering, GUI, and the tiny renderer
